## Student-facing?

Tick one. The "What's new" check fails if a PR changes `src/`, `public/` or `index.html` without either.

- [ ] This changes something students can see, so it adds an entry to `src/data/updates.ts` (the title screen's "What's new" bell).
- [ ] Nothing students can see changed (tests, docs, CI, infra, refactors), so no entry is needed.
